title: Classify Task Result
description: Return of the classify-task agent when its prompt gives paths: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the task type, how sure it is, and why

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question the task left unresolved, or an empty string

confidence.description: certain only when the task leaves no reasonable doubt between types
